perItemFindings.label: S1
perItemFindings.one_line: P1 encodes rewards as a finite alphabet `Fin nR`, but the core permits arbitrary bounded real rewards via `K(dy,...)`; this silently shrinks the model class, so the planned upper bounds prove only a finite-support subclass.

verbatim_critique: Replan S1/S2 to preserve the core's real-valued bounded reward law, or establish a genuine equivalence. The recorded finite-support restriction is not faithful for the core headline; matching lower and upper bounds only within the restricted subclass does not repair it.
